# Hue/lightness builder call site

Where the colour stage calls the hue/lightness builder; Caduceus hooks here.

**Category:** hook site · **Address:** `0x60518615` (runtime cached) · <span class="pill pill-released">Camera-confirmed</span>
{ .facts }

**Build:** [om3 firmware 1.1, build 1100](../firmware/om3-1100.md) · **Cameras:** [OM SYSTEM OM-3](../cameras/om3.md)

A single call into the builder at 0x60518381; execution resumes at 0x6051861a. Runtime addresses are the decoded main plus 0x60021020.
